CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_sp_daily_metrics_compute(p_day date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  s timestamptz := (p_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago');
  e timestamptz := ((p_day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago');
  us timestamptz := (p_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC');
  ue timestamptz := ((p_day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC');
  v_usd numeric := public.fn_sp_setting('usd_per_diamond', 0.01);
  v_big numeric := public.fn_sp_setting('big_diamond_move', 10000);
  g jsonb; m jsonb; d jsonb; sv jsonb; pl jsonb; ag jsonb; h jsonb; en jsonb; sec jsonb; cap jsonb; fr jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- GROWTH -------------------------------------------------------------------
  WITH hu AS (SELECT * FROM smarter_private.sp_real_humans),
       fixtures AS (SELECT count(*) n FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.created_at >= s AND p.created_at < e
                      AND NOT COALESCE(p.is_horse,false) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hu WHERE hu.id = p.id))
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'signups', (SELECT count(*) FROM hu WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'signups_email_confirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM hu WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e AND email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL),
    'signups_phone_verified', (SELECT count(*) FROM hu WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e AND phone_verified),
    'fixture_accounts_created', (SELECT n FROM fixtures),
    'humans_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM hu WHERE created_at < e),
    'humans_phone_verified', (SELECT count(*) FROM hu WHERE phone_verified),
    'otp_codes_sent', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.sms_otp_send_log WHERE purpose = 'phone_verify' AND outcome = 'sent' AND created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'otp_send_failures', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.sms_otp_send_log WHERE purpose = 'phone_verify' AND outcome = 'failed' AND created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    /* WHO CAN STILL EARN THE WELCOME PACKAGE BY PHONE (2026-10-23): verified,
       or a US player whose package is not already in the Mint register.
       Phone verification is US only; an owner grant leaves nothing to claim. */
    'signups_phone_eligible', (SELECT count(*) FROM hu JOIN public.profiles pp ON pp.id = hu.id
                                WHERE hu.created_at >= s AND hu.created_at < e
                                  AND (hu.phone_verified
                                       OR ((pp.country IS NULL OR pp.country IN ('United States', 'US'))
                                           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ca_mint_ledger ml WHERE ml.op_id = 'signup:' || hu.id::text)))),
    'signups_phone_skipped', (SELECT count(*) FROM hu JOIN auth.users au ON au.id = hu.id
                               WHERE hu.created_at >= s AND hu.created_at < e AND NOT hu.phone_verified
                                 AND au.raw_user_meta_data ? 'phone_prompt_dismissed_at'),
    'active_humans', (SELECT count(*) FROM hu WHERE last_seen >= s),
    'active_horses', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE is_horse AND last_seen >= s),
    'vip_active_humans', (SELECT count(*) FROM hu WHERE is_vip AND (vip_expires_at IS NULL OR vip_expires_at > e)),
    'referral_signups', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.referrals WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'top_referrer', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('username', p.username, 'count', x.n)
                       FROM (SELECT referrer_id, count(*) n FROM public.referrals WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e
                              GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1) x JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = x.referrer_id),
    'club_joins', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.club_entry_events WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e
                     AND flow = 'join' AND event_name = 'completed' AND outcome = 'succeeded'
                     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hu WHERE hu.id = club_entry_events.actor_id)),
    'clubs_created', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.club_entry_events WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e
                     AND flow = 'create' AND event_name = 'completed' AND outcome = 'succeeded'
                     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hu WHERE hu.id = club_entry_events.actor_id)),
    'retention', jsonb_build_object(
       'd1', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('cohort', count(*), 'returned', count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen >= s))
                FROM hu WHERE created_at >= s - interval '1 day' AND created_at < s),
       'd7', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('cohort', count(*), 'returned', count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen >= s))
                FROM hu WHERE created_at >= s - interval '7 days' AND created_at < s - interval '6 days'),
       'd30', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('cohort', count(*), 'returned', count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen >= s))
                FROM hu WHERE created_at >= s - interval '30 days' AND created_at < s - interval '29 days')),
    'funnel_30d', (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
         'signed_up', count(*),
         'email_confirmed', count(*) FILTER (WHERE email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL),
         'phone_verified', count(*) FILTER (WHERE phone_verified),
         'joined_club', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.club_members cm WHERE cm.user_id = hu.id)),
         'played_hand', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.club_member_play_totals t WHERE t.user_id = hu.id AND t.hands > 0)))
       FROM hu WHERE created_at >= e - interval '30 days' AND created_at < e)
  ) INTO g;

  -- MONEY (one pass over the day's ledger) ------------------------------------
  WITH cl AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT category, from_type, to_type, club_id, amount, from_entity_id, to_entity_id
      FROM public.chip_ledger WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
  ra AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.player_id, r.club_id, r.rake_amount, COALESCE(p.is_horse, false) horse
      FROM public.rake_attributions r LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = r.player_id
     WHERE r.club_id IS NOT NULL AND r.created_at >= s AND r.created_at < e)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    -- cash rake to a union wallet, plus a standalone club's cash rake, which is retired
    'cash_rake', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM cl WHERE from_type = 'table_stack'
                                   AND (category = 'rake' OR (category = 'burn' AND to_type = 'chip_retirement'))),0),2),
    'tournament_rake', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM cl WHERE category = 'rake' AND from_type = 'prize_liability'),0),2),
    'rake_paid_by_humans', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(rake_amount) FROM ra WHERE NOT horse),0),2),
    'rake_paid_by_horses', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(rake_amount) FROM ra WHERE horse),0),2),
    'rakeback_paid', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM cl WHERE category = 'rakeback'),0),2),
    'commissions_paid', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM cl WHERE category = 'commission'),0),2),
    'bbj_contributions', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM cl WHERE category = 'bbj_contribution'),0),2),
    'minted', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM cl WHERE from_type IN ('system_mint','issuance_reserve')),0),2),
    'burned', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM cl WHERE to_type IN ('system_burn','chip_retirement')),0),2),
    'promo_and_leaderboard', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM cl WHERE category IN ('promo_send','promo','leaderboard_payout','club_opening_allocation')
         OR (category = 'ticket_issue' AND from_type = 'promo_wallet' AND to_type = 'escrow')),0),2),
    -- by the club each player sat in; the ledger books a union's tables under the union
    'rake_by_club', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x.rake DESC) FROM (
         SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Unknown') club, round(sum(ra.rake_amount),2) rake
           FROM ra LEFT JOIN public.clubs c ON c.id = ra.club_id
          GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'top_human_rakers', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x.rake DESC) FROM (
         SELECT p.username, round(sum(ra.rake_amount),2) rake FROM ra JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = ra.player_id
          WHERE NOT ra.horse AND ra.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM smarter_private.sp_real_humans)
          GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'bbj_pool_total', (SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(main_balance,0)+COALESCE(backup_balance,0)+COALESCE(promo_balance,0)),0),2)
                         FROM public.bbj_pools WHERE merged_into_pool_id IS NULL),
    'supply_unexplained', (SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(unexplained),0),2) FROM public.ca_supply_snapshots
                            WHERE taken_at >= s AND taken_at < e AND unexplained IS NOT NULL),
    -- Cash rake leaves the table stack two ways: to the union wallet for a
    -- club in a union, or retired (burned) for a standalone club. The rollup
    -- counts both, so the ledger side does too.
    'ledger_rake_utc_day', (SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(amount),0),2) FROM public.chip_ledger
                            WHERE created_at >= us AND created_at < ue AND from_type = 'table_stack'
                              AND (category = 'rake' OR (category = 'burn' AND to_type = 'chip_retirement'))),
    'rollup_rake_utc_day', (SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(rake_amount),0),2) FROM public.club_rake_daily_user WHERE day = p_day)
  ) INTO m;

  -- DIAMONDS ------------------------------------------------------------------
  WITH dt AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT user_id,
           /* A HOUSE PAYOUT FILED AS A TRANSFER IS NOT A TRANSFER (2026-10-16).
              Diamond Spins daily net settlements and Wheel cards are booked as
              type 'transfer' with the player as their own counterparty. They
              are house movements, so they count as given out or taken in under
              their own names instead of vanishing with peer transfers. */
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(transaction_type, type) = 'transfer'
                     AND metadata->>'reference_id' LIKE 'diamond-spin-day:%' THEN 'diamond_spins_daily_net'
                WHEN COALESCE(transaction_type, type) = 'transfer'
                     AND metadata->>'reference_id' LIKE 'wheel-cards%' THEN 'wheel_cards'
                ELSE COALESCE(transaction_type, type, 'unknown') END tt, amount, created_at
      FROM public.diamond_transactions WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'given_out', COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM dt WHERE amount > 0 AND tt NOT IN ('arena_withdraw','transfer')),0),
    'given_by_source', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(tt, n) FROM (SELECT tt, sum(amount) n FROM dt
         WHERE amount > 0 AND tt NOT IN ('arena_withdraw','transfer') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12) x), '{}'::jsonb),
    'taken_in', COALESCE((SELECT -sum(amount) FROM dt WHERE amount < 0 AND tt NOT IN ('arena_deposit','transfer')),0),
    'taken_by_sink', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(tt, n) FROM (SELECT tt, -sum(amount) n FROM dt
         WHERE amount < 0 AND tt NOT IN ('arena_deposit','transfer') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12) x), '{}'::jsonb),
    'into_club_arena', COALESCE((SELECT -sum(amount) FROM dt WHERE tt = 'arena_deposit'),0),
    'out_of_club_arena', COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM dt WHERE tt = 'arena_withdraw'),0),
    'transfers', COALESCE((SELECT sum(abs(amount)) FROM dt WHERE tt = 'transfer'),0),
    'circulation', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(balance),0) FROM public.user_diamond_balance),
    -- what real players hold is the liability; horse and fixture balances are house money
    'circulation_players', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(b.balance),0) FROM public.user_diamond_balance b
                             WHERE b.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM smarter_private.sp_real_humans)),
    'big_movements', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (
         SELECT p.username, dt.tt AS type, dt.amount, to_char(dt.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago','HH12:MI AM') at_ct
           FROM dt LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = dt.user_id
          WHERE abs(dt.amount) > v_big AND dt.tt NOT IN ('arena_deposit','arena_withdraw')
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.users au WHERE au.id = dt.user_id AND au.email ~* '\.invalid$')
          ORDER BY abs(dt.amount) DESC LIMIT 10) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'usd_per_diamond', v_usd
  ) INTO d;
  d := d || jsonb_build_object(
    'net_issued', (d->>'given_out')::numeric - (d->>'taken_in')::numeric,
    'circulation_usd', round((d->>'circulation_players')::numeric * v_usd, 2));

  -- SALES AND VIP -------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'diamond_packages', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('count', count(*), 'usd', COALESCE(sum(price_usd),0))
                           FROM public.diamond_purchases WHERE completed_at >= s AND completed_at < e AND status = 'completed'),
    'vip_new', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('count', count(*), 'usd', COALESCE(sum(price_usd),0))
                  FROM public.vip_subscriptions WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'vip_cancelled', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.vip_subscriptions WHERE canceled_at >= s AND canceled_at < e),
    'vip_plan_switches', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.vip_plan_switches WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'vip_lifetime', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('count', count(*), 'usd', COALESCE(sum(price_usd),0))
                       FROM public.vip_lifetime_purchases WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e AND status = 'completed'),
    'merch', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('count', count(*), 'usd', COALESCE(sum(total_usd),0))
                FROM public.merchandise_orders WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e
                 AND status NOT IN ('pending','cancelled','canceled','abandoned','expired')),
    'merch_shipped', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.merchandise_orders WHERE shipped_at >= s AND shipped_at < e),
    'merch_delivered', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.merchandise_orders WHERE delivered_at >= s AND delivered_at < e),
    'store_purchases', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('count', count(*), 'diamonds', COALESCE(sum(net),0))
                          FROM public.ca_commerce_purchases WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'club_shop_purchases', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.club_shop_purchases WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'refunds_usd', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(refunded_amount_cents) FROM public.diamond_purchases WHERE refunded_at >= s AND refunded_at < e),0)/100.0
                       + COALESCE((SELECT sum(refunded_amount_cents) FROM public.merchandise_orders WHERE refunded_at >= s AND refunded_at < e),0)/100.0
                       + COALESCE((SELECT sum(refunded_amount_cents) FROM public.vip_lifetime_purchases WHERE reversed_at >= s AND reversed_at < e),0)/100.0, 2),
    'disputes', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.vip_lifetime_purchases WHERE dispute_id IS NOT NULL AND updated_at >= s AND updated_at < e)
              + (SELECT count(*) FROM public.diamond_purchase_disputes WHERE (to_jsonb(diamond_purchase_disputes)->>'created_at')::timestamptz >= s
                   AND (to_jsonb(diamond_purchase_disputes)->>'created_at')::timestamptz < e),
    'stripe_events', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('total', count(*), 'not_completed', count(*) FILTER (WHERE (processing_status IS NULL OR processing_status NOT IN ('done','completed'))))
                        FROM public.stripe_webhook_events WHERE processed_at >= s AND processed_at < e)
  ) INTO sv;
  sv := sv || jsonb_build_object('revenue_usd', round(
      (sv#>>'{diamond_packages,usd}')::numeric + (sv#>>'{vip_new,usd}')::numeric
    + (sv#>>'{vip_lifetime,usd}')::numeric + (sv#>>'{merch,usd}')::numeric, 2));

  -- CLUB ARENA PLAY -------------------------------------------------------------
  WITH hh AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT tournament_id, has_human, pot_size, big_blind, table_id FROM public.hand_history WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
  hb AS (SELECT * FROM public.ca_horse_fleet_heartbeat WHERE beat_at >= s AND beat_at < e)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'hands', (SELECT count(*) FROM hh),
    'hands_cash', (SELECT count(*) FROM hh WHERE tournament_id IS NULL),
    'hands_tournament', (SELECT count(*) FROM hh WHERE tournament_id IS NOT NULL),
    'hands_with_human', (SELECT count(*) FROM hh WHERE has_human),
    'tables_dealing', (SELECT count(DISTINCT table_id) FROM hh),
    'biggest_pot', (SELECT max(pot_size) FROM hh),
    'tournaments_started', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(t, n) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(tournament_type,'OTHER') t, count(*) n
         FROM public.tournaments WHERE started_at >= s AND started_at < e GROUP BY 1) x), '{}'::jsonb),
    'tournaments_completed', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(t, n) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(tournament_type,'OTHER') t, count(*) n
         FROM public.tournaments WHERE ended_at >= s AND ended_at < e AND status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY 1) x), '{}'::jsonb),
    'tournaments_cancelled', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournaments WHERE status = 'CANCELLED' AND updated_at >= s AND updated_at < e),
    'biggest_prize_pool', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('name', name, 'prize_pool', prize_pool) FROM public.tournaments
         WHERE ended_at >= s AND ended_at < e AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY prize_pool DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1),
    'lightning_hands', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.lightning_hand WHERE formed_at >= s AND formed_at < e),
    'horse_fleet', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('beats', count(*), 'degraded_beats', count(*) FILTER (WHERE degraded),
         'max_stuck', max(horses_stuck), 'unknown_stuck_beats', count(*) FILTER (WHERE horses_stuck IS NULL), 'stuck_samples', count(horses_stuck), 'avg_seated', round(avg(horses_seated)), 'max_seated', max(horses_seated))
         || jsonb_build_object('max_degraded_run', (SELECT COALESCE(max(n), 0) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT COALESCE(degraded, false) AS is_degraded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE(degraded, false)) OVER (ORDER BY beat_at, id) AS grp FROM hb) r WHERE r.is_degraded GROUP BY grp) q)) FROM hb),
    'horse_net_bb', (SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(net_bb),0),1) FROM public.horse_daily_nets WHERE day = p_day),
    'horse_rake_bb', (SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(rake_bb),0),1) FROM public.horse_daily_nets WHERE day = p_day)
  ) INTO pl;

  -- AGENTS AND CASHOUTS ---------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'cashouts_requested', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('count', count(*), 'amount', COALESCE(sum(amount),0)) FROM public.cashout_requests WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'cashouts_completed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.cashout_requests WHERE completed_at >= s AND completed_at < e),
    'agent_credit_invoices', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.credit_invoices WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'invoices_issued', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(invoice_type, n) FROM (SELECT invoice_type, count(*) n FROM public.settlement_invoices
         WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e AND invoice_type <> 'transaction_receipt' GROUP BY 1) x), '{}'::jsonb),
    'agent_funding', round(COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM public.club_wallet_transactions WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e AND type ~* 'agent'),0),2),
    'commission_settlements', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('count', count(*), 'amount', COALESCE(sum(amount),0)) FROM public.agent_commission_settlements WHERE paid_at >= s AND paid_at < e)
  ) INTO ag;

  -- PLATFORM HEALTH -------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Resolve the original classifier once, rather than once per signal.
  WITH digest_health_humans AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM smarter_private.sp_real_humans)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'breaks', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('total', count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict IN ('pass','fail')), 'passed', count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'pass'))
                 FROM public.ca_break_scorecards WHERE recorded_at >= s AND recorded_at < e),
    'deploys', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('attempted', count(*), 'shipped', count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.shipped OR a.superseded OR a.retried),
                                     'superseded', count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.superseded),
                                     'retried', count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.retried AND NOT a.superseded))
                  /* A RELEASE THAT STOOD DOWN FOR A NEWER ONE THAT SHIPPED DID
                     SHIP (2026-10-16). The receiver stands an older revision
                     down when protected main has moved on; the newer revision
                     contains it. Counted as shipped only when the revision it
                     names really shipped within twelve hours either side. */
                  FROM (SELECT x.shipped,
                               (NOT x.shipped AND EXISTS (
                                  SELECT 1 FROM public.ca_engine_deploy_attempts y
                                   WHERE y.shipped
                                     AND y.target_sha = substring(x.reason from 'protected main had moved to ([0-9a-f]{40})')
                                     AND y.at BETWEEN x.at - interval '12 hours' AND x.at + interval '12 hours')) AS superseded,
                               /* A REFUSED ATTEMPT THAT ITS OWN RETRY SHIPPED DID SHIP
                                  (2026-10-23): the same exact target shipped later
                                  within the same twelve-hour window. */
                               (NOT x.shipped AND EXISTS (
                                  SELECT 1 FROM public.ca_engine_deploy_attempts z
                                   WHERE z.shipped
                                     AND z.target_sha = x.target_sha
                                     AND z.at > x.at
                                     AND z.at <= x.at + interval '12 hours')) AS retried
                          FROM public.ca_engine_deploy_attempts x WHERE x.at >= s AND x.at < e) a),
    'alerts_new', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('critical', count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical'), 'warning', count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'warning'))
                     FROM public.operational_alert_events WHERE received_at >= s AND received_at < e
                      AND investigation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'informational' AND payload->>'snapshot_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'update_new' AND NOT COALESCE((source LIKE 'local.%-runtime' AND status='resolved' AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'resolves')='string'),false) AND severity IN ('critical','warning')),
    'alerts_top', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT alertname, severity, count(*) n FROM public.operational_alert_events
         WHERE received_at >= s AND received_at < e AND investigation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'informational' AND payload->>'snapshot_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'update_new' AND NOT COALESCE((source LIKE 'local.%-runtime' AND status='resolved' AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'resolves')='string'),false) AND severity IN ('critical','warning')
         GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 8) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'alert_names', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(alertname, n) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(alertname,'unknown') alertname, count(*) n FROM public.operational_alert_events
         WHERE received_at >= s AND received_at < e AND investigation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'informational' AND payload->>'snapshot_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'update_new' AND NOT COALESCE((source LIKE 'local.%-runtime' AND status='resolved' AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'resolves')='string'),false) AND severity = 'critical'
         GROUP BY 1) x), '{}'::jsonb),
    'alerts_fixed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.operational_alert_events WHERE investigation_touched_at >= s AND investigation_touched_at < e
                       AND investigation_status = 'verified_fixed'),
    'financial_alerts_new', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('critical', count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical'), 'warning', count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'warning'))
                               FROM public.financial_alerts WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'financial_alerts_open', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.financial_alerts WHERE NOT resolved AND severity IN ('critical','warning')),
    'drift_open', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_drift_incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL),
    'drift_past_deadline', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_drift_incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL AND deadline_at < e),
    'ledger_findings', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_ledger_invariant_findings WHERE found_at >= s AND found_at < e),
    'diamond_incidents_new', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_diamond_incidents WHERE occurred_at >= s AND occurred_at < e AND severity <> 'info'),
    'client_errors', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(occurrences),0) FROM public.client_error_events WHERE received_at >= s AND received_at < e),
    'client_errors_top', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(code,''), error_name, 'unknown') k, sum(occurrences) n
         FROM public.client_error_events WHERE received_at >= s AND received_at < e GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'db_timeouts', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(occurrences),0) FROM public.client_error_events WHERE received_at >= s AND received_at < e AND code = '57014'),
    -- An app crash is an error boundary catching a render failure. The auth
    -- flow's own failure reports (boundary 'auth': a wrong password, an
    -- unconfirmed email) and delivery probes share client_crash_log but are
    -- not crashes (2026-10-16: both "app crashes" on Oct 15 were login form
    -- refusals, DailyDigest.client_crash).
    'crashes', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.client_crash_log WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e
                  AND boundary IS DISTINCT FROM 'auth' AND error_name IS DISTINCT FROM 'Probe'),
    'signup_errors', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.signup_errors WHERE occurred_at >= s AND occurred_at < e),
    'probe_failures', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(probe_name, n) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(probe_name,'unknown') probe_name, count(*) n FROM public.probe_heartbeats
         WHERE occurred_at >= s AND occurred_at < e AND status = 'failed' GROUP BY 1) x), '{}'::jsonb),
    -- signals between two horses are the house playing itself; only pairs with a real player count
    'collusion_signals', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_collusion_signals c WHERE c.detected_at >= s AND c.detected_at < e AND NOT COALESCE(c.both_cert,false)
                           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM digest_health_humans hu WHERE hu.id IN (c.user_a, c.user_b))),
    'collusion_signals_horse_only', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_collusion_signals c WHERE c.detected_at >= s AND c.detected_at < e AND NOT COALESCE(c.both_cert,false)
                           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM digest_health_humans hu WHERE hu.id IN (c.user_a, c.user_b))),
    'beta_accounts_flagged', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT p.username) FROM public.ca_collusion_signals c
         JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id IN (c.user_a, c.user_b)
        WHERE c.detected_at >= s AND c.detected_at < e AND p.username ~* '^(kingfish|danimal)'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'push', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('sent', COALESCE(sum(sent),0), 'failed', COALESCE(sum(failed),0))
               FROM public.push_dispatch_runs WHERE started_at >= s AND started_at < e)
  ) INTO h;
  -- PHASE 4 HEALTH KEYS (2026-10-31) -------------------------------------------
  h := jsonb_set(h, '{breaks,gate_opened}', to_jsonb((SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_break_scorecards
         WHERE recorded_at >= s AND recorded_at < e AND gate_opened)));
  h := jsonb_set(h, '{alerts_new,critical_distinct}', to_jsonb((SELECT count(DISTINCT alertname) FROM public.operational_alert_events
         WHERE received_at >= s AND received_at < e AND investigation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'informational'
           AND payload->>'snapshot_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'update_new' AND NOT COALESCE((source LIKE 'local.%-runtime' AND status='resolved' AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'resolves')='string'),false) AND severity = 'critical')));
  h := h || jsonb_build_object(
    'engine_restarts_outside_break', (SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(payload->'alert'->>'startsAt', event_key))
         FROM public.operational_alert_events WHERE alertname = 'EngineRestartedOutsideTheBreak' AND status = 'firing'
          AND received_at >= s AND received_at < e),
    'financial_alerts_open_actionable', (SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(source || ':' || (context->>'dedupe_key'), id::text))
         FROM public.financial_alerts WHERE NOT resolved AND severity IN ('critical','warning')
          AND source NOT LIKE 'drift_incident:%'),
    'tournaments_stuck_running', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournaments t
         WHERE t.status = 'RUNNING' AND NOT COALESCE(t.on_break, false)
           AND COALESCE(t.started_at, t.start_time) < now() - interval '30 minutes'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hand_history hh WHERE hh.tournament_id = t.id
                            AND hh.created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes')),
    'tournaments_past_start_registering', (SELECT overdue_start FROM public.fn_tournament_metrics()),
    'drift_open_manual_needed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_drift_incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL
         AND auto_repair_status = 'manual_needed'),
    'client_errors_distinct_users', (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM public.client_error_events
         WHERE received_at >= s AND received_at < e AND user_id IS NOT NULL),
    'client_errors_top_share', (SELECT round(max(n)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(n), 0), 4) FROM (
         SELECT sum(occurrences) n FROM public.client_error_events WHERE received_at >= s AND received_at < e
          GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(code,''), error_name, 'unknown')) x));

  -- ENGAGEMENT ------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'challenges_claimed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.user_daily_challenges WHERE claimed_at >= s AND claimed_at < e),
    'trivia_sessions', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.trivia_sessions WHERE submitted_at >= s AND submitted_at < e),
    'training_answers', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.training_answers WHERE answered_at >= s AND answered_at < e),
    'social_posts', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.social_posts WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e AND NOT COALESCE(is_deleted,false)),
    'social_comments', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.social_comments WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e AND NOT COALESCE(is_deleted,false)),
    'social_likes', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.social_likes WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e),
    'reels', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.social_reels WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e AND NOT COALESCE(is_deleted,false)),
    'videos_added', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.video_library_videos WHERE created_at >= s AND created_at < e)
  ) INTO en;

  -- SECURITY --------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'admin_ids', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM public.profiles WHERE is_admin OR role IN ('admin','super_admin','owner')), '[]'::jsonb),
    'admins', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(id, COALESCE(username, 'unknown')) FROM public.profiles WHERE is_admin OR role IN ('admin','super_admin','owner')), '{}'::jsonb),
    'signup_abuse_hits', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.signup_abuse_log WHERE last_signup_at >= s AND last_signup_at < e AND abuse_flags IS NOT NULL AND abuse_flags <> '{}'::jsonb),
    'accounts_deleted', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_profile_deletions WHERE deleted_at >= s AND deleted_at < e AND NOT COALESCE(is_horse,false)),
    'login_probe_failures', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.probe_heartbeats WHERE occurred_at >= s AND occurred_at < e AND status = 'failed' AND probe_name ~* 'login|recovery|auth')
  ) INTO sec;
  sec := sec || jsonb_build_object(
    'recovery_probe_failures', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.probe_heartbeats WHERE occurred_at >= s AND occurred_at < e
         AND status = 'failed' AND probe_name = 'recovery-probe'),
    'signup_probe_failures', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.probe_heartbeats WHERE occurred_at >= s AND occurred_at < e
         AND status = 'failed' AND probe_name = 'signup-probe'),
    'trigger_audit_failures', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.probe_heartbeats WHERE occurred_at >= s AND occurred_at < e
         AND status = 'failed' AND probe_name = 'trigger-audit'));

  -- CAPACITY (instant reading at snapshot time) ----------------------------------
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'db_size_gb', round(pg_database_size(current_database()) / 1073741824.0, 1),
    'connections', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity),
    'active_queries', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active'),
    'cache_hit_pct', (SELECT round(100.0 * sum(blks_hit) / NULLIF(sum(blks_hit) + sum(blks_read), 0), 2) FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database()),
    'saturation_selftests_failed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.db_saturation_selftest_log
         WHERE (to_jsonb(db_saturation_selftest_log)->>'ok') = 'false'
           AND COALESCE((to_jsonb(db_saturation_selftest_log)->>'ran_at')::timestamptz, (to_jsonb(db_saturation_selftest_log)->>'created_at')::timestamptz) >= s
           AND COALESCE((to_jsonb(db_saturation_selftest_log)->>'ran_at')::timestamptz, (to_jsonb(db_saturation_selftest_log)->>'created_at')::timestamptz) < e)
  ) INTO cap;

  -- FRESHNESS: newest row per source when computed ---------------------------------
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'chip_ledger', (SELECT max(created_at) FROM public.chip_ledger WHERE created_at > now() - interval '2 days'),
    'hand_history', (SELECT max(created_at) FROM public.hand_history WHERE created_at > now() - interval '2 days'),
    'diamond_transactions', (SELECT max(created_at) FROM public.diamond_transactions WHERE created_at > now() - interval '2 days'),
    'horse_heartbeat', (SELECT max(beat_at) FROM public.ca_horse_fleet_heartbeat),
    'supply_snapshots', (SELECT max(taken_at) FROM public.ca_supply_snapshots),
    'rake_rollup', (SELECT max(computed_at) FROM public.club_rake_daily_user),
    'alert_inbox', (SELECT max(received_at) FROM public.operational_alert_events),
    'break_scorecards', (SELECT max(recorded_at) FROM public.ca_break_scorecards)
  ) INTO fr;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('day', p_day, 'window', jsonb_build_object('start', s, 'end', e),
    'growth', g, 'money', m, 'diamonds', d, 'sales', sv, 'play', pl, 'agents', ag,
    'health', h, 'engagement', en, 'security', sec, 'capacity', cap, 'freshness', fr,
    'computed_at', clock_timestamp());
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_sp_digest_daily_results_compute(p_day date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
BEGIN
RETURN (
WITH win AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT p_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' s,
 (p_day+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' e, public.fn_diamond_arena_club() da
), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.hand_id,f.user_id,f.net,f.players_dealt, CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN COALESCE(p.is_horse,false) THEN 'horses' ELSE 'humans' END cohort
 FROM public.ca_hand_facts f CROSS JOIN win LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=f.user_id
 WHERE f.played_at>=win.s AND f.played_at<win.e AND f.tournament_id IS NULL
 AND f.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM win.da
), tday AS MATERIALIZED (
 -- Tournaments whose start (started_at, else scheduled start_time, else
 -- created_at) falls on this Chicago day. Each branch is an index range.
 SELECT t.id FROM public.tournaments t,win WHERE t.started_at>=win.s AND t.started_at<win.e
 UNION
 SELECT t.id FROM public.tournaments t,win WHERE t.started_at IS NULL AND t.start_time>=win.s AND t.start_time<win.e
 UNION
 SELECT t.id FROM public.tournaments t,win WHERE t.started_at IS NULL AND t.start_time IS NULL AND t.created_at>=win.s AND t.created_at<win.e
), posted AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.from_type,l.to_type,l.from_entity_id,l.to_entity_id,l.amount,l.category,l.tournament_id FROM public.chip_ledger l,win WHERE l.created_at>=win.s AND l.created_at<win.e
 AND l.status='posted' AND l.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM win.da
), ledger AS MATERIALIZED (
 -- Legs with no tournament, or a tournament with no known start, keep their
 -- posting day. Every leg of a tournament that started today is included,
 -- whenever it was posted; legs of tournaments started on other days are not.
 -- The start lookup is a per-row primary-key probe, never a table-wide hash.
 SELECT p.* FROM posted p WHERE p.tournament_id IS NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT p.* FROM posted p WHERE p.tournament_id IS NOT NULL
 AND (SELECT COALESCE(t.started_at,t.start_time,t.created_at) FROM public.tournaments t WHERE t.id=p.tournament_id) IS NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT l.from_type,l.to_type,l.from_entity_id,l.to_entity_id,l.amount,l.category,l.tournament_id FROM public.chip_ledger l JOIN tday d ON d.id=l.tournament_id,win
 WHERE l.status='posted' AND l.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM win.da
), legs AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.tournament_id, CASE WHEN l.to_type='player_wallet' THEN l.to_entity_id ELSE l.from_entity_id END user_id,
 CASE WHEN l.to_type='player_wallet' THEN l.amount ELSE -l.amount END net
 FROM ledger l WHERE tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND
 ((from_type='player_wallet' AND to_type='prize_liability') OR (from_type='prize_liability' AND to_type='player_wallet'))
), results AS (
 SELECT 'cash' kind,cohort,user_id,sum(net) net FROM facts GROUP BY 2,3
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'tournament',CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN COALESCE(p.is_horse,false) THEN 'horses' ELSE 'humans' END,
 l.user_id,sum(l.net) FROM legs l LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id=l.user_id GROUP BY 2,3
), cohorts AS (
 SELECT k.kind,c.cohort,COALESCE(sum(r.net),0) net,
 COALESCE(sum(GREATEST(r.net,0)),0) wins,COALESCE(sum(GREATEST(-r.net,0)),0) losses,
 count(r.user_id) players FROM (VALUES('cash'),('tournament')) k(kind)
 CROSS JOIN (VALUES('horses'),('humans'),('unknown')) c(cohort)
 LEFT JOIN results r ON r.kind=k.kind AND r.cohort=c.cohort GROUP BY 1,2
), amounts AS (
 SELECT COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM ledger WHERE category='rake' AND from_type='table_stack'),0) cash_rake,
 COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM ledger WHERE category='rake' AND from_type='prize_liability'),0) tournament_rake,
 COALESCE((SELECT sum(b.amount) FROM public.bbj_contributions b,win WHERE b.created_at>=win.s AND b.created_at<win.e AND b.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM win.da),0) bbj,
 COALESCE((SELECT sum(net) FROM facts),0) cash_net,
 COALESCE((SELECT sum(net) FROM legs),0) tournament_net,
 -- Change in the ledger's prize-liability bucket. Internal transfers cancel.
 COALESCE((SELECT sum((CASE WHEN to_type='prize_liability' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN from_type='prize_liability' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)) FROM ledger),0) prize_liability_change,
 -- External funding out of prize liabilities is positive; funding in negative.
 -- Wallet results and rake are already counted separately above.
 COALESCE((SELECT sum((CASE WHEN from_type='prize_liability' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN to_type='prize_liability' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)) FROM ledger
 WHERE from_type<>'player_wallet' AND to_type<>'player_wallet' AND category<>'rake'),0) other_prize_movements
), coverage AS (
 SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE actual<>expected OR invalid>0) incomplete_hands,
 COALESCE(sum(invalid),0) invalid_seats FROM (
 SELECT hand_id,count(DISTINCT user_id) actual,max(players_dealt) expected,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE net IS NULL OR players_dealt IS NULL) invalid FROM facts GROUP BY hand_id) h
), settlements AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT d.* FROM win CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.fn_tournament_conservation_deltas(win.s-interval '1 microsecond',win.e+interval '7 days') d
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.tournaments t WHERE t.id=d.id AND t.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM win.da)
 AND (d.id IN (SELECT id FROM tday) OR (d.ended_at<win.e AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.tournaments t WHERE t.id=d.id
 AND COALESCE(t.started_at,t.start_time,t.created_at) IS NOT NULL)))
), supply AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT count(*) samples,count(DISTINCT date_trunc('hour',taken_at)) hours,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE unexplained IS NULL OR basis_version IS NULL) unknown,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE unexplained<>0) nonzero,count(DISTINCT basis_version) bases,
 COALESCE(sum(abs(unexplained)),0) absolute_unexplained,COALESCE(sum(unexplained),0) net_unexplained,
 min(taken_at) first_at,max(taken_at) last_at
 FROM public.ca_supply_snapshots,win WHERE taken_at>=win.s AND taken_at<win.e
), report AS (
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('day',p_day,'window',jsonb_build_object('start',win.s,'end',win.e),
 'results',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(kind,groups) FROM (SELECT kind,jsonb_object_agg(cohort,jsonb_build_object('net',net,'wins',wins,'losses',losses,'players',players)) groups FROM cohorts GROUP BY kind) g),
 'kingfish',jsonb_build_object('included',true,'user_id','47965354-0e56-43ef-931c-ddaab82af765',
 'cash_net',COALESCE((SELECT net FROM results WHERE kind='cash' AND user_id='47965354-0e56-43ef-931c-ddaab82af765'),0),
 'tournament_net',COALESCE((SELECT net FROM results WHERE kind='tournament' AND user_id='47965354-0e56-43ef-931c-ddaab82af765'),0)),
 'chip_supply',to_jsonb(supply)||jsonb_build_object('expected_hours',extract(epoch FROM win.e-win.s)/3600,
 'status',CASE WHEN supply.hours<>extract(epoch FROM win.e-win.s)/3600 OR supply.unknown>0 OR supply.bases<>1 THEN 'unverified'
 WHEN supply.absolute_unexplained<>0 THEN 'discrepancy' ELSE 'balanced' END,
 'basis','Existing hourly physical-store inventory versus journaled issuance and retirement, including wallets, cash stacks, BBJ, reserves, prize/ticket liabilities and post-hand transit. Checks intervals ending during this Chicago day; not exact midnight inventory cuts.'),
 'tournament_settlements',jsonb_build_object('checked',(SELECT count(*) FROM settlements),
 'unbalanced',(SELECT count(*) FROM settlements WHERE delta IS NULL OR delta<>0),
 'absolute_drift',COALESCE((SELECT sum(abs(delta)) FROM settlements),0),
 'off',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'delta',delta)) FROM settlements WHERE delta IS NULL OR delta<>0),'[]'::jsonb),
 'basis','Existing independent completed/cancelled paid non-spin tournament conservation check; lifetime event balances for events that started this Chicago day.'),
 'reconciliation',to_jsonb(a)||jsonb_build_object(
 'cash_residual',cash_net+cash_rake+bbj,
 'raw_residual',cash_net+tournament_net+cash_rake+tournament_rake+bbj,
 'accounted_residual',cash_net+tournament_net+cash_rake+tournament_rake+bbj+prize_liability_change+other_prize_movements,
 'incomplete_cash_hands',coverage.incomplete_hands,'invalid_cash_seats',coverage.invalid_seats,
 'unknown_players',(SELECT sum(players) FROM cohorts WHERE cohort='unknown'),
 'status',CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.sp_daily_metrics WHERE day=p_day) OR p_day>=(statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date OR supply.hours<>extract(epoch FROM win.e-win.s)/3600 OR supply.unknown>0 OR supply.bases<>1 THEN 'unverified' WHEN supply.absolute_unexplained<>0 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM settlements WHERE delta IS NULL OR delta<>0) OR coverage.incomplete_hands>0 OR coverage.invalid_seats>0 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM cohorts WHERE cohort='unknown' AND players>0)
 OR cash_net+cash_rake+bbj<>0 OR cash_net+tournament_net+cash_rake+tournament_rake+bbj+prize_liability_change+other_prize_movements<>0
 THEN 'discrepancy' ELSE 'balanced' END),
 'basis','Chicago calendar day; chips only, Diamond Arena excluded. Wins/losses are positive/negative player net results within each game type. Cash uses recorded completed-hand facts. Tournament uses posted wallet entries, rebuys, add-ons, prizes, bounties and refunds, not tournament play stacks. Kingfish is included among humans. Every tournament leg is recorded on the Chicago day the tournament started, even when posted after midnight. Raw rake + BBJ + wins - losses is shown before the prize-liability and other funding bridge. Balanced verifies these recorded flows, not every physical wallet or unrecorded transaction.') value
 FROM win,amounts a,coverage,supply
) SELECT value FROM report);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_sp_digest_house_figures(p_day date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET statement_timeout TO '30s'
AS $function$
WITH win AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT p_day d, p_day-6 wk, date_trunc('month',p_day)::date mo,
        (SELECT public.fn_diamond_arena_club()) da
), days AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.day,
 COALESCE((m.metrics#>>'{money,bbj_contributions}')::numeric,0) bbj,
 COALESCE((m.metrics#>>'{money,cash_rake}')::numeric,0) cash_rake,
 (m.metrics#>>'{play,horse_net_bb}')::numeric horse_net_bb_utc
 FROM public.sp_daily_metrics m, win
 WHERE m.day BETWEEN LEAST(win.wk,win.mo) AND win.d
), others AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (f.played_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date AS day,
 sum(f.net) net, sum(COALESCE(r.rake_amount,0)) rake,
 sum(COALESCE(r.bbj_attributed_contribution,0)) bbj
 FROM win, public.profiles p
 JOIN public.ca_hand_facts f ON f.user_id=p.id AND f.tournament_id IS NULL
 LEFT JOIN public.rake_attributions r ON r.hand_id=f.hand_id AND r.player_id=f.user_id AND r.club_id IS NOT NULL
 WHERE NOT COALESCE(p.is_horse,false)
 AND f.played_at >= LEAST(win.wk,win.mo)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'
 AND f.played_at < (win.d+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'
 AND f.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM win.da
 GROUP BY 1
), horse AS (
 SELECT d.day, d.bbj, d.horse_net_bb_utc,
 -(d.cash_rake+d.bbj)-COALESCE(o.net,0) net,
 d.cash_rake-COALESCE(o.rake,0) rake,
 d.bbj-COALESCE(o.bbj,0) bbj_paid,
 -(COALESCE(o.net,0)+COALESCE(o.rake,0)+COALESCE(o.bbj,0)) vs_others
 FROM days d LEFT JOIN others o ON o.day=d.day
), agg AS (
 SELECT
 (SELECT jsonb_build_object('net',round(net,2),'rake',round(rake,2),'bbj',round(bbj_paid,2),
   'vs_others',round(vs_others,2),'net_bb_utc',horse_net_bb_utc,'days',1)
  FROM horse, win WHERE horse.day=win.d) hd,
 (SELECT jsonb_build_object('net',round(sum(net),2),'rake',round(sum(rake),2),'bbj',round(sum(bbj_paid),2),
   'vs_others',round(sum(vs_others),2),'net_bb_utc',sum(horse_net_bb_utc),'days',count(*))
  FROM horse, win WHERE horse.day>=win.mo) hm,
 (SELECT round(bbj,2) FROM days, win WHERE days.day=win.d) bd,
 (SELECT round(sum(bbj),2) FROM days, win WHERE days.day>=win.wk) bw,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM days, win WHERE days.day>=win.wk) bwn,
 (SELECT round(sum(bbj),2) FROM days, win WHERE days.day>=win.mo) bm,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM days, win WHERE days.day>=win.mo) bmn
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('day',win.d,'week_from',win.wk,'month_from',win.mo,
 'bbj_rake',jsonb_build_object('day',agg.bd,'week',agg.bw,'week_days',agg.bwn,'month',agg.bm,'month_days',agg.bmn),
 'horse_cash',jsonb_build_object('day',agg.hd,'month',CASE WHEN (agg.hm->>'days')::int>0 THEN agg.hm END),
 'basis','Central days from the nightly snapshots. BBJ rake is the cash pots'' bad beat jackpot drop. Horse cash result is chips: the day''s cash rake and BBJ less every other account''s cash result; tournaments are excluded.',
 'generated_at',clock_timestamp())
FROM win, agg;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_sp_original_alert_proof(p_event_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE original public.operational_alert_events%ROWTYPE;
        witness text; kind text; reference text; verified boolean:=false;
        reviewed boolean:=false; review_note text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO original FROM public.operational_alert_events WHERE id=p_event_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('reviewed',false,'verified',false,'kind',NULL,'reference',NULL);
  END IF;
  IF original.source IN ('financial-alerts-backfill','financial-alerts-updates') THEN
    SELECT financial.id::text INTO witness FROM public.financial_alerts financial
    WHERE financial.id=CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(original.payload#>>'{original_event,id}','uuid')
      THEN (original.payload#>>'{original_event,id}')::uuid END
      AND financial.source=original.alertname
      AND CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(original.payload#>>'{original_event,created_at}','timestamp with time zone')
        THEN financial.created_at=(original.payload#>>'{original_event,created_at}')::timestamptz ELSE false END
      AND financial.resolved IS TRUE AND financial.resolved_at>=financial.created_at;
    IF FOUND THEN kind:='financial_alert'; reference:='Resolved financial alert '||witness; END IF;
  ELSIF original.source='alertmanager' THEN
    SELECT closed.id::text INTO witness FROM public.operational_alert_events closed
    WHERE closed.source='alertmanager' AND closed.status='resolved'
      AND closed.alertname=original.alertname
      AND nullif(original.payload#>>'{alert,fingerprint}','') IS NOT NULL
      AND closed.payload#>>'{alert,fingerprint}'=original.payload#>>'{alert,fingerprint}'
      AND nullif(original.payload#>>'{alert,startsAt}','') IS NOT NULL
      AND closed.payload#>>'{alert,startsAt}'=original.payload#>>'{alert,startsAt}'
      AND jsonb_typeof(original.payload#>'{alert,labels}')='object'
      AND original.payload#>>'{alert,labels,alertname}'=original.alertname
      AND closed.payload#>'{alert,labels}'=original.payload#>'{alert,labels}'
      AND closed.payload#>>'{alert,status}'='resolved'
      AND COALESCE(closed.last_received_at,closed.received_at)>=COALESCE(original.last_received_at,original.received_at)
      AND CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(original.payload#>>'{alert,startsAt}','timestamp with time zone')
        AND pg_input_is_valid(closed.payload#>>'{alert,endsAt}','timestamp with time zone')
        THEN (closed.payload#>>'{alert,endsAt}')::timestamptz >= (original.payload#>>'{alert,startsAt}')::timestamptz
        ELSE false END
    ORDER BY closed.id DESC LIMIT 1;
    IF FOUND THEN kind:='alertmanager_resolved'; reference:='Matching resolved Alertmanager event '||witness; END IF;
  ELSIF original.source='sp-critical-pager'
    AND original.alertname='CriticalPage.midway_free_buy_missing' THEN
    SELECT t.id::text INTO witness
    FROM public.tournaments t
    JOIN public.tournament_terminal_settlements s ON s.tournament_id=t.id
    JOIN public.tournament_escrow e ON e.tournament_id=t.id
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(original.payload#>'{detail,name}')='string'
      AND jsonb_typeof(original.payload#>'{detail,starts}')='string'
      AND jsonb_typeof(original.payload#>'{detail,expected_format}')='string'
      AND original.payload#>>'{detail,expected_format}' IN ('regular','pko','aiof','mystery')
      AND t.union_id='fade0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid
      AND t.name=original.payload#>>'{detail,name}'
      AND t.start_time=CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(original.payload#>>'{detail,starts}','timestamp with time zone')
        THEN (original.payload#>>'{detail,starts}')::timestamptz END
      AND public.fn_ca_midway_free_buy_format(t.id)=original.payload#>>'{detail,expected_format}'
      AND public.fn_ca_midway_free_buy_slot_format(t.id)=original.payload#>>'{detail,expected_format}'
      AND t.status='COMPLETED' AND t.current_players=0
      AND s.settled_at>=original.received_at AND s.completed_at=t.ended_at
      AND s.escrow_closed_at=e.terminal_closed_at AND e.terminal_closed_at>=original.received_at
      AND s.prize_pool=t.prize_pool AND s.cash_payout_total=s.prize_pool
      AND s.bounty_pool=t.bounty_pool AND s.bounty_payout_total=s.bounty_pool
      AND e.prize_balance=0 AND e.bounty_balance=0 AND e.fee_balance=0
    ORDER BY t.created_at,t.id LIMIT 1;
    IF FOUND THEN kind:='midway_slot_receipt'; reference:='Completed original Midway slot with terminal receipt '||witness; END IF;
  END IF;

  -- original_source_review_v1: owner notification carries the exact drift UUID,
  -- original event time and type. No title similarity or unscoped inference.
  IF kind IS NULL AND original.source='owner-operational-notifications'
     AND original.payload#>>'{original_notification,type}'='financial_incident' THEN
    SELECT i.id::text INTO witness FROM public.ca_drift_incidents i
    WHERE i.id=CASE WHEN (original.payload#>>'{original_notification,data,incident_id}') ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
      THEN (original.payload#>>'{original_notification,data,incident_id}')::uuid END
      AND i.status='resolved' AND i.closure_basis IS DISTINCT FROM 'aged_out_unverified'
      AND length(btrim(COALESCE(i.root_cause,'')))>=40
      AND NULLIF(btrim(i.resolution),'') IS NOT NULL
      AND i.correction_ref ~* '^(migration[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]|PR[[:space:]]*#[0-9]|chip_ledger[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]|correction:[^[:space:]]|(ruling:|verified:|no-change-needed:)[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]])'
      AND CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(original.payload#>>'{original_notification,created_at}','timestamp with time zone')
        THEN (original.payload#>>'{original_notification,created_at}')::timestamptz
          BETWEEN i.detected_at AND i.resolved_at ELSE false END;
    IF FOUND THEN kind:='original_drift_resolution';reference:='Verified original drift incident '||witness;END IF;
  END IF;
  IF original.investigation_status='informational' THEN
    SELECT x.value->>'finding' INTO review_note
    FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(original.investigation)='object' THEN original.investigation ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) x
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value)='object'
      AND length(btrim(COALESCE(x.value->>'finding','')))>=40
      AND NULLIF(btrim(x.value->>'reviewed_by'),'') IS NOT NULL
      AND CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(x.value->>'reviewed_at','timestamp with time zone')
        THEN (x.value->>'reviewed_at')::timestamptz BETWEEN
          COALESCE(original.last_received_at,original.received_at) AND now() ELSE false END
    ORDER BY x.value->>'reviewed_at' DESC LIMIT 1;
    reviewed:=FOUND;
    IF reviewed THEN reference:=COALESCE(reference,review_note);END IF;
  END IF;
  verified:=kind IS NOT NULL;

  IF NOT verified AND original.investigation_status='verified_fixed'
     AND COALESCE(original.last_received_at<=COALESCE(original.investigation_touched_at,original.received_at),
                  original.last_received_at IS NULL) THEN
    verified:=true; kind:='verified_fixed';
    reference:=COALESCE(NULLIF(original.investigation->>'fixing_pr',''),'Verified original alert '||original.id::text);
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('reviewed',reviewed OR verified OR COALESCE(original.investigation_status='historical',false),
    'verified',verified,'kind',kind,'reference',reference);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.reliability_proved_source_resolution(p_incident_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'smarter_private'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.reliability_incidents i
   WHERE i.id=p_incident_id AND i.source IN ('owner-operational-notifications','sp-critical-pager','sp-daily-digest','ca-stall-watch')
     AND i.status='stale_unverified' AND i.resolution_state='none'
     AND i.last_resolved_at>=i.last_firing_received_at
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.reliability_alert_members x
       WHERE x.fingerprint=i.fingerprint AND x.last_firing_at>=i.opened_at AND x.status<>'resolved')
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.reliability_observations o
       JOIN public.operational_alert_events e ON e.id=o.inbox_event_id
       JOIN smarter_private.reliability_alert_members m ON m.fingerprint=i.fingerprint
         AND m.member_key=e.source||':'||regexp_replace(e.event_key,':resolved$','')
       WHERE o.incident_id=i.id AND o.status='resolved' AND e.status='resolved'
         AND e.source=i.source AND m.status='resolved'
         AND m.episode='row:'||e.id::text AND m.last_firing_at>=i.opened_at
         AND o.observed_at=m.last_event_at AND o.observed_at<=i.last_resolved_at
         AND o.created_at>=m.last_firing_received_at
         AND ((e.source='owner-operational-notifications'
               AND public.fn_sp_original_alert_proof(e.id)->>'kind'='original_drift_resolution')
           OR (((e.source='sp-critical-pager' AND e.alertname='CriticalPage.stuck_tournament')
                  OR (e.source='sp-daily-digest' AND e.alertname='DailyDigest.stuck_tournament'))
               AND e.payload->>'resolved_by'='fn_sp_critical_scan'
               AND pg_input_is_valid(e.payload->>'resolved_at','timestamptz')
               AND CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(e.payload#>>'{detail,tournament_id}','uuid')
                 THEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tournaments t
                   WHERE t.id=(e.payload#>>'{detail,tournament_id}')::uuid AND t.status='RUNNING')
                 ELSE false END)
           -- A STALLED TABLE (20261118164804): proved by re-measuring the table the
           -- stall watch named - no longer open, or dealing again since it fired.
           OR (e.source='ca-stall-watch' AND e.alertname='TableStoppedDealing'
               AND pg_input_is_valid(e.payload->>'table_id','uuid')
               AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tables tb
                     WHERE tb.id=(e.payload->>'table_id')::uuid AND coalesce(tb.lifecycle,'')<>'closed'
                       AND tb.status IN ('waiting','running','active') AND NOT coalesce(tb.is_deleted,false))
                 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hand_history h
                     WHERE h.table_id=(e.payload->>'table_id')::uuid AND h.created_at>m.last_firing_at))))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sp_prune_hand_history(p_batch integer DEFAULT 2500)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_days integer;
  v_window interval;
  v_doomed uuid[];
  v_keepers uuid[];
  v_deleted integer := 0;
  v_round integer;
  -- THE SCAN RESUMES WHERE IT LEFT OFF (2026-10-26, migration 20261026133101).
  -- v_resume_after is the newest created_at this pass has examined; the
  -- Bounded raw pages advance even when every guard retains their rows.
  -- The uuid tie-breaker prevents equal timestamps from skipping later rows.
  v_pass_length constant interval := interval '60 minutes';
  v_resume_after timestamptz;
  v_pass_started timestamptz;
  v_reached timestamptz;
  v_resume_id uuid;
  v_reached_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Retention never holds the maintenance lane while the platform is frozen.
  IF public.fn_platform_frozen() IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
  -- A waiting fixture reserves its turn on a lane used only by retention.
  IF pg_catalog.pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(530090,2) IS NOT TRUE THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
  -- Preserve the original maintenance/settlement owner before any ledger read.
  IF pg_catalog.pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(530090,1) IS NOT TRUE THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
  -- Recheck after admission before the policy and accounting reads.
  IF public.fn_platform_frozen() IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
  SELECT greatest(coalesce(horse_retention_days,8),1)
    INTO v_days FROM public.hand_history_retention_policy LIMIT 1;
  IF v_days IS NULL THEN v_days := 8; END IF;
  v_window := make_interval(days=>v_days);
  INSERT INTO smarter_private.hand_history_prune_cursor(singleton) VALUES(true) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  SELECT c.resume_after,c.pass_started_at,c.resume_id INTO v_resume_after,v_pass_started,v_resume_id
    FROM smarter_private.hand_history_prune_cursor c WHERE c.singleton FOR UPDATE;
  IF v_pass_started IS NULL OR (v_resume_after IS NOT NULL AND v_resume_id IS NULL
     AND v_pass_started<clock_timestamp()-v_pass_length) THEN
    v_resume_after := NULL;
    v_resume_id := NULL;
    v_pass_started := clock_timestamp();
  END IF;

  -- One raw page per original cron transaction; COMMIT releases both shared lanes.
  v_doomed := NULL;
    v_keepers := NULL;
    -- Bound the scan BEFORE accounting/F06 guards: LIMIT on eligible rows
    -- cannot bound the retained prefix. MATERIALIZED prevents guard pushdown.
    WITH scanned AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT hh.id,hh.created_at FROM public.hand_history hh
       WHERE hh.created_at<now()-v_window
         AND hh.created_at>=COALESCE(v_resume_after,'-infinity'::timestamptz)
         AND (v_resume_id IS NULL OR (hh.created_at,hh.id)>(v_resume_after,v_resume_id))
       ORDER BY hh.created_at,hh.id
       LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(p_batch,1),250)
    ), cited AS MATERIALIZED (
      -- THE CITATIONS ARE READ ONCE PER PAGE (2026-11-07). The anti-join
      -- below used to unpack every case's source_refs for every hand: 245
      -- cases x 200 hands = 49,000 jsonb_array_elements calls, 820 ms of each
      -- page. Same rows, same kinds, same text comparison, read once.
      SELECT DISTINCT sr->>'id' AS id
        FROM smarter_private.original_inventory_restoration_cases rc,
             jsonb_array_elements(rc.source_refs) sr
       WHERE sr->>'kind' IN ('atomic_economics','signed_economics')
    ), candidates AS (
      SELECT hh.id,hh.players,hh.created_at,
             (hh.table_id IS NULL AND hh.tournament_id IS NULL
              AND hh.players = '[]'::jsonb) AS unattached
        FROM scanned scan CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
          -- Keep every guard downstream of a bounded point read even when
          -- the planner chooses hash joins. Lock only this page; refuse a
          -- concurrently held row through the existing SKIP LOCKED rule.
          SELECT locked.* FROM public.hand_history locked
           WHERE locked.id=scan.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        ) hh
       WHERE hh.has_human IS FALSE
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.hand_submissions original
           WHERE original.table_id=hh.table_id AND original.hand_number=hh.hand_number
             AND (original.request#>'{p_hand_row,has_human}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb)
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.poker_diamond_jackpot_hits dj
           WHERE dj.table_id=hh.table_id AND dj.hand_number=hh.hand_number AND dj.paid)
         AND hh.reported IS NOT true
         -- AN OPERATOR-ARCHIVED TABLE KEEPS ITS HANDS (2026-11-07).
         -- smarter_private.tournament_abort_archived_write_guard refuses every
         -- write to hand_history, hand_atomic_commits and hand_submissions on a
         -- table holding a tournament_abort_hand_dispositions row. One such
         -- hand among the doomed rolled the whole page back, so the cursor
         -- never advanced: 896 failed runs from 19:56 UTC, each ~4 s of work
         -- undone. The operator's archive is the record; it is retained here,
         -- and the scanned page still moves the cursor past it.
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.tournament_abort_hand_dispositions ad
                          WHERE ad.table_id=hh.table_id)
         AND smarter_private.horse_cash_retention_accounting_ready(hh.table_id,hh.hand_number)
         AND (hh.table_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hand_atomic_commits a WHERE a.hand_id=hh.id AND a.table_id=hh.table_id AND a.hand_number=hh.hand_number AND isfinite(a.post_commit_completed_at) AND a.post_commit_completed_at<now()-v_window AND a.post_commit_result->>'ok'='true'))
         AND hh.created_at<now()-v_window
         -- A SEALED RESTORATION CASE KEEPS THE HANDS IT CITES (2026-10-14). The
         -- finite witness re-reads the atomic commit of every cited hand; a pruned
         -- hand voids the case and halts the weekly union accounting for ever.
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cited WHERE cited.id=hh.id::text)
         AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.bbj_payouts bp
            WHERE bp.table_id=hh.table_id AND bp.hand_number=hh.hand_number)
         AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.hand_projection_outbox o WHERE o.hand_id=hh.id)
         AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_knockout_candidates c
            WHERE c.hand_id=hh.id AND c.state='pending')
         -- AN UNSETTLED TOURNAMENT KEEPS ITS HANDS (2026-10-02). A tournament
         -- hand is evidence until its event's money is settled: the event is
         -- COMPLETED or CANCELLED, its bounty pool is fully paid, and its
         -- escrow, when it has one, is closed. PKO 3f19bd70 lost the only record
         -- of who knocked out whom while 2,310.00 of its bounty pool was unpaid.
         -- Cash rake records are never deleted here (20260925143224), so a cash
         -- week keeps its per-player rakeback basis settled or not.
         -- Migration 20261002082452.
         AND (hh.tournament_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.tournaments ut
            WHERE ut.id=hh.tournament_id
              AND (upper(COALESCE(ut.status::text,'')) NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED','CANCELED')
                   OR COALESCE(ut.bounty_pool,0)>COALESCE(ut.bounty_pool_paid,0)
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_escrow ue
                               WHERE ue.tournament_id=ut.id AND ue.closed_at IS NULL))))
         -- A hand whose F06 permit is still 'reserved' is unresolved, and this
         -- row is original evidence for it:
         -- smarter_private.f06_retired_origin_snapshot and
         -- smarter_private.f06_retained_mtt_abort_snapshot both read
         -- public.hand_history and public.hand_atomic_commits. All four DELETEs
         -- below key off the ids chosen here, so excluding the hand at this one
         -- point retains its history, atomic commit, rake attribution and
         -- player-index rows together. Excluding it from the candidate set
         -- rather than from each DELETE also keeps it out of v_keepers, so no
         -- has_human=true is written that would retain it past its permit, and
         -- it never consumes a p_batch slot. Retention ends when the permit
         -- leaves 'reserved'; every other row prunes on the same boundary as
         -- before. The lookup goes through the SECURITY DEFINER helper added by
         -- migration 20260920232341, because this function is SECURITY INVOKER
         -- and its search_path does not include smarter_private.
         AND NOT smarter_private.f06_hand_cards_unresolved(hh.table_id,hh.hand_number::bigint)
         -- AND the hand that IS the table's current movement boundary, for a
         -- table F06 can still be asked to move. The guard above protects the
         -- unresolved HAND -- which never started and has no row here -- so it
         -- reached straight past the hands the table already dealt, and
         -- smarter_private.f06_movement_prior loads the last of those by
         -- max(hand_number) and validates its post-commit payload hash,
         -- request hash and stack receipt out of it. Delete it and that table
         -- raises F06_MOVEMENT_PRIOR_INCOMPLETE for ever: on 2026-09-25 one
         -- seated player in a RUNNING freeroll was about six retention runs
         -- from exactly that. One hand per live table, and it stops being the
         -- boundary as soon as the table deals another. Migration
         -- 20260925210126.
         AND NOT smarter_private.f06_movement_boundary_retained(hh.table_id,hh.hand_number::bigint)
         -- Missing/blank classification or conflicting ownership stays retained.
         -- A known Spin's history remains evidence until canonical terminal
         -- state commits; do not require a first legacy receipt to exist.
         -- AN UNATTACHED ROW IS NOT A HAND ANYBODY PLAYED (2026-10-05). A row
         -- with no table, no tournament and nobody dealt in is the settled-hand
         -- fixture tests/e2e/production-daily-missions.spec.ts inserts and
         -- deletes; a run killed before its finally block leaves it behind.
         -- The engine never writes one. tb.id=hh.table_id is never true for a
         -- NULL table_id, so the EXISTS below excluded such a row from every
         -- run, and even admitted, an empty player list classifies as human
         -- below and would be kept for ever. Every guard above still governs
         -- it (both f06 helpers read false for a NULL table_id, measured on
         -- all eight such rows). Migration 20261005111120.
         AND ((hh.table_id IS NULL AND hh.tournament_id IS NULL
               AND hh.players = '[]'::jsonb) OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.tables tb
           LEFT JOIN public.tournaments t ON t.id=tb.tournament_id
            WHERE tb.id=hh.table_id
              AND (hh.tournament_id IS NULL
                   OR hh.tournament_id=tb.tournament_id)
              AND (
                (hh.tournament_id IS NULL AND tb.tournament_id IS NULL)
                OR (
                  t.id IS NOT NULL
                  AND NULLIF(btrim(t.variant::text),'') IS NOT NULL
                  AND NULLIF(btrim(t.tournament_type::text),'') IS NOT NULL
                  AND (
                    (lower(t.variant::text)<>'spin'
                     AND upper(t.tournament_type::text)<>'SPIN')
                    OR (upper(COALESCE(t.status::text,''))='COMPLETED'
                        AND EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_terminal_settlements terminal
                           WHERE terminal.tournament_id=t.id))
                    OR (upper(COALESCE(t.status::text,'')) IN ('CANCELLED','CANCELED')
                        AND EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_cancellation_receipts cancellation
                           WHERE cancellation.tournament_id=t.id))
                  )
                )
              )
         ))
       ORDER BY hh.created_at
       LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(p_batch,1),250)
    ), classified AS (
      SELECT c.id,c.created_at,
        CASE
          WHEN c.unattached THEN false
          WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.players) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN true
          WHEN jsonb_array_length(c.players)=0 THEN true
          ELSE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
              FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.players) e
              LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=(CASE
                WHEN length(e.value->>'userId')=36
                 AND (e.value->>'userId') ~
                   '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
                THEN (e.value->>'userId')::uuid END)
             WHERE p.id IS NULL OR p.is_horse IS NOT true)
        END AS is_human
        FROM candidates c
    )
    SELECT array_agg(id) FILTER (WHERE is_human IS false),
           array_agg(id) FILTER (WHERE is_human IS DISTINCT FROM false),
           (SELECT created_at FROM scanned ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT id FROM scanned ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1)
      INTO v_doomed,v_keepers,v_reached,v_reached_id FROM classified;

    IF v_reached IS NULL THEN
      v_resume_after := now()-v_window;
      v_resume_id := NULL;
    ELSE
    v_resume_after := v_reached;
    v_resume_id := v_reached_id;
    IF v_keepers IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(v_keepers)>0 THEN
      UPDATE public.hand_history SET has_human=true WHERE id=ANY(v_keepers);
    END IF;
    IF v_doomed IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(v_doomed)>0 THEN
      -- A RECORDED EARNING SOURCE IS NOT HAND HISTORY (2026-09-25).
      -- This line used to delete the pruned hands rake attributions, and
      -- every run of sp_prune_hand_history_10m raised
      -- recorded_cash_earning_source_is_immutable for it: the trigger
      -- accounting_cash_source_immutable refuses to move an attribution once
      -- accounting_cash_accrual_batches holds a batch for its rake record.
      -- The trigger is right and the DELETE was never required: there is no
      -- foreign key from rake_attributions.hand_id to hand_history.id. It
      -- also fired trg_ca_club_rake_daily_user_del, which would have
      -- decremented the per-club per-user daily rake rollup - the rakeback
      -- basis - for every horse in every pruned hand (CLAUDE.md 10.5).
      -- Retention is a storage decision about hand HISTORY (10.5, eight
      -- days); the money ledger is not pruned, so attributions are kept.
      -- RETENTION CLOSES THE SETTLEMENT REQUEST IT PRUNES (2026-09-28).
      -- The commit row below is how fn_ca_resume_hand_submission knows a
      -- hand finished. Deleting it without closing the request leaves the
      -- table looking mid-hand for ever, and the next successor refuses to
      -- start it (HAND_SUBMISSION_HANDOFF_STATE_CHANGED). Receipted here,
      -- in the same transaction, while table_id and hand_number are still
      -- readable from the rows about to go.
      PERFORM smarter_private.hand_submission_retention_disposal(v_doomed,
        'Retention pruned this settled hand under the horse hand-history policy; its durable record (atomic commit and history) has aged out, so the retained settlement request is closed here and must never be applied again. Zero credit: the hand settled when it was played.');
      PERFORM smarter_private.compact_horse_settlement_keys(v_doomed);
      PERFORM smarter_private.compact_horse_cash_play_contents(v_doomed);
      PERFORM smarter_private.archive_pruned_hand_index(v_doomed);
      DELETE FROM public.hand_atomic_commits WHERE hand_id=ANY(v_doomed);
      DELETE FROM public.hand_history WHERE id=ANY(v_doomed);
      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_round=ROW_COUNT;
      v_deleted := v_deleted+v_round;
    END IF;
    END IF;
  UPDATE smarter_private.hand_history_prune_cursor
     SET resume_after=v_resume_after,resume_id=v_resume_id,pass_started_at=v_pass_started,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
   WHERE singleton;
  RETURN v_deleted;
END;
$function$
